recommendation: Keep the audit commit for core and do not re-add the extension to core source. If the work group wants the current required binding changed to preferred, or wants to revisit SDC profile usage, open follow-up work in the Extension Pack or SDC IG.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 request to support QuestionnaireResponse completion mode by defining a standard CodeableConcept extension using v3 ParticipationMode concepts Electronic, Verbal, and Written, with optional use in the SDC IG.
initial_application: Jira comments cite SVN #14772 and SDC Git 18c1f08. In the core repository, git-svn commit b8c5990ac5ad735ba1e8e836fd8a4c6fd3534a3e for build@14772 explicitly listed issue 15514 and added the QuestionnaireResponse completionMode extension row plus ValueSet-questionnaireresponse-mode with ELECTRONIC, VERBAL, and WRITTEN concepts; later R4/R4B history and R5 XML source carried that extension.
additional_context: The current core build includes QuestionnaireResponse but no active source file for the completionMode extension or value set. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the QuestionnaireResponse extension/value set files as part of moving extensions out of R5 core source, and the current FHIR Extension Pack now owns StructureDefinition-questionnaireresponse-completionMode and ValueSet-questionnaireresponse-mode. Historical core and current Extension Pack definitions use a required binding despite the Jira resolution text saying preferred; no related Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence found a later decision specifically about that binding-strength mismatch. Zulip evidence showed the SDC QuestionnaireResponse profile had completionMode/signature slices in 2022, supporting the external SDC component.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. Re-adding or editing the extension in core would target the wrong source because the authoritative current artifact is in hl7.fhir.uv.extensions, outside this FHIR core checkout/build.
